segments.name: Smart home solutions
segments.description: Provides an enterprise smart home platform of software, hardware and professional services for property owners, operators, site teams and residents.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment, which is also its only reportable segment as its CODM

revenueModel.text: Property owners, property managers and residents pay subscription fees for Hosted Services and buy smart home devices with installation and implementation services.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue primarily from sales of smart home systems that enable property owners and property managers to have visibility and control over assets, while providing all-in-one home control offerings for residents.
